findings.message: Allow statement contains unsupported condition operators.  For Allow, FedFence erases them as monotone restrictions and proves the over-approximation.
Allow statement has no provider-qualified GitHub subject condition; it is not a positive proof by itself, and safety is decided on the issuer over-approximation.
Allow statement has no provider-qualified audience condition; safety is decided on issuer audiences.
Effective policy admits an issuer-mintable subject outside intent.
Effective policy admits an issuer-mintable audience outside intent.
